correctness.rationale: Re-ran all three scripts: spectral gap gives invariant min 8 and empty kernel intersection; degeneracy values +1/-1/0 confirmed; threshold ladder confirmed. Checked (i) theta0(A) derivation term-by-term and Hopf phase mismatch; checked (ii) Folland lambda=2(p+q+2pq) kernel only (1,0),(0,1) with weights +-1 so no invariant kernel, and next lambda>=4 gives gap 8 rigorously. Checked (iii) IFT on S3 uses only Folland-Stein theory, unaffected by quotient degeneracy; qualitative tubular uniqueness follows from invertible L0 plus analytic O(t) perturbation. Explicit delta0=1/10 and r0=0.05 are order-of-magnitude illustrations resting on stated crude bound C~8, not separately certified, but existence of some delta0>0 and no-accumulation conclusion are fully proved.

originality.rationale: Fused search over literal, equivalent-weight, and dominance queries returned no prior stating the combined anti-diagonal invariant gap 8 plus tubular no-bifurcation plus Grushin obstruction. Nearest priors (Jerison-Lee standard-sphere theory, Gamara-Yacoub existence, Cheng-Malchiodi-Yang Rossi mass, Afeltra-Ho-Pinamonti flow non-convergence, Malchiodi-Uguzzoni bubble second variation) were screened in full/snippet and concern different objects (all bubbles, minimizers, mass negativity, bubble Morse index one) and do not imply the constant-reference invariant nondegeneracy or the Hopf-vs-anti-diagonal correction. No database table records this invariant.

value.rationale: EMERGENT_FINDING genuinely arose from testing reference-branch bifurcation for target alternative (A): computing the invariant gap forced the symmetry check, which exposed the wrong-Hopf ansatz and Grushin obstruction blocking the global step. The headline is a citable structural theorem: explicit degeneracy function, sharp exact gap 8, tubular uniqueness ruling out local symmetry breaking, and a well-posed Grushin quotient target. Object and invariant were motivated before computation, value not known or mechanically implied, future symmetric-Yamabe work can need it. Honestly scoped as local only, global dichotomy left open.
